reason: The revised contract no longer exposes linked ingredient references: instructions are plain authored strings and only final wording is observable. Catalog priority, chained substitutions, equipment feasibility, scaling, and complete diagnostics constrain outcomes but do not force ordered whole-recipe rewrite passes. Direct text editing, recursive or graph search over substitutions, copied mutable recipes, regenerated outputs, positional side indexes, or a private semantic linked model are materially different correct organizations. The hidden linked-recipe/pass architecture is therefore optional rather than named or behaviorally aliased.
